note: Conflicts between sources, or between a source and the published corpus, that need research or an expert ruling before they can be resolved. See README.md for the format. `sync_source_conflicts` materialises the affected rows as ReviewNote records so each conflict reaches the editorial queue rather than living only in this file.

conflicts.title: Hannan records class 9 nouns with class 6 plurals; Fortune does not list class 9 among class 6's correlating singulars
conflicts.summary: Fortune Vol 1 3.3.9 (printed p.52) states class 6 nouns 'are correlative plurals of nouns in cll. 5, 11, 21, 1a, 1 and 14' and enumerates them; class 9 is absent from that list. Hannan records class 9 nouns whose plural prefix is ma-, a class 6 shape.

sources.claim: budiriro n 9, pl: mab- -- a class 9 noun with a class 6 plural
sources.verbatim: budiriro [HHHL]KMZ n 9, pl: mab-, Success. 2. Progress (cultural).

evidence: The scan was read directly with tools/render_dictionary_entry.py; this is not an extraction artefact.
Several other class 9 rows in the audit work list carry mab-/mabv-/mabw- shapes, so this is likely a group rather than one entry.
conflicts.resolution_needed: A ruling on whether the Hannan class assignment or the Fortune correlation list governs. Needs either a third source that states class 9's plural behaviour, or a Shona grammarian's judgement. Until then the plural derivation refuses these entries, which is the correct behaviour under the evidence policy.
conflicts.impact: 9 records in the audit work list carry the shape; their plurals are withheld

conflicts.title: Hannan's class 2b label does not match Fortune's class 2b definition
conflicts.summary: Hannan labels the amai/ambuya-type nouns 'n 2b'. Fortune Vol 1 3.3.5 defines class 2b as the prefix /a-/ occurring with two stems only (amai, ambuya) and gives no plural. There is no NounClass row for 2b, so those records carry no class at all.

sources.claim: class 2b is /a-/, occurring with the two stems mai and mbuya
amai, amaiguru, ambuya and relatives are labelled n 2b

evidence: Nine published records carry the parser's class value '2b' with no NounClass row to resolve to.
Their plurals are recorded as full forms (madzimai, vadzimbuya), so the plural itself is attested and publishes; only the class is unresolved.
conflicts.resolution_needed: Decide whether to add NounClass rows for Hannan's sub-labels (2b, 2m) with a concord taken from a source, or to remap them to an existing class. Adding a row requires an evidence-backed concord; the number of affected records is small (10).
conflicts.impact: 10 published records with no noun class

conflicts.title: The dictionary text extraction contains Cyrillic homoglyphs
conflicts.field: source quality (all fields read from the text)
conflicts.summary: local_source_cache/hannan_dictionary.txt contains 1,313 Cyrillic lookalike characters (U+0430 а, U+0442 т, U+041C М and others) where Latin letters belong. Any value read from that file could carry them into a published surface form.

sources.claim: e.g. map- appears as mаp- with U+0430

evidence: Counted by scanning the file for the Cyrillic block: 1,313 characters.
Reading from the text was introduced for plural prefixes at the same time as the normaliser, so no homoglyph has reached a published form.
conflicts.resolution_needed: None for the plural path, which normalises before use. Worth re-running the extraction or normalising at ingest if the text is ever used for other fields; an unresolved homoglyph is invisible in review.
conflicts.impact: none on published data; a latent hazard for any future consumer of that file
